documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration Of Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September 2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Reconciliation Of Share Capital Audit For The Quarter Ended 30Th September 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Pricol Ltd reported consolidated revenue of Rs.1083.58 crores and an EBITDA of Rs.123.69 crores with an EBITDA margin of 11.41% for Q1 FY27, reflecting a 23.46% year-on-year revenue growth aided by strong industry growth and new product introductions. Management noted that EBITDA faced headwinds due to surging polymer prices, LPG costs, freight rates, and minimum wage increases in three operating states, but expects to recover these delayed earnings through indexation in the next two to three quarters. The company is undergoing a significant 700-crore capex cycle over 18 to 24 months, including 400 crores for the polymer vertical, and is pursuing a proposed demerger of its core driver information system and connected vehicle business to attract strategic investments and global technology partners. Pricol Limited released its investor presentation for the first quarter of FY27, reporting a revenue from operations of INR 1,083.58 Crores and a PAT of INR 67.02 Crores. The document outlines company background, financial statements, historical performance, and key highlights including awards received from Suzuki Motorcycle India and Ashok Leyland.

guidance.claim: The blended steady-state EBITDA margin for normal operations is maintained between 12.5% and 13%.
guidance.quote: Our ideal margin level for normal operations should be as I have always maintained between 12.5-13% which is the steady state margin so that we are not losing business, maintaining our share of business

guidance.claim: Polymer business turnover is expected to comfortably reach about Rs. 2000 crores post capex from the current Rs. 1000 crores capacity.
guidance.quote: With the capacity that we are creating, we should comfortably go to about Rs. 2000 crores of turnover from our current Rs. 1000 crores of turnover that we are capable of producing.

guidance.claim: Management stated that exports are targeted to reach 10% of revenue in the coming years.
guidance.quote: And our goal is to take it to 10% of revenue in the coming years.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry demand continues to be robust overall.
demand_outlook.quote: In terms of industry outlook, demand continues to be robust, but the resumption of the war in Iran and those neighboring regions will continue to have an impact on the rupee

demand_outlook.claim: Polymer space growth is muted due to lack of capacity rather than a lack of business.
demand_outlook.quote: In the Polymer space, the growth is going to be muted as mentioned by me in the last call because of lack of capacity, not lack of business.

demand_outlook.claim: TFT cluster penetration in two-wheelers is currently around 7-8% of total production.
demand_outlook.quote: About 7-8% of the total 2-wheelers produced is having TFT clusters.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that there will be a softening of earnings and slowing of the automotive sector due to geopolitical headwinds.
demand_outlook.quote: So, while we are not scaling back on any of our critical activities that is going to hamper the growth of the company, we do believe that there will be softening of earnings and slowing of the whole automotive sector on account of these geopolitical headwinds that are actually sending ripples across the world.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that polymer, aluminum, semiconductor, and freight costs have risen significantly alongside a falling rupee.
demand_outlook.quote: Polymer prices have gone up by about 55%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that April was reasonably okay due to pipeline inventory and raw materials bought at earlier rates.
demand_outlook.quote: April was reasonably okay because we had a lot of pipeline inventory, pipeline stocks and raw material that were bought at earlier rates.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has embarked on an overall capex cycle of Rs. 700 crores across all divisions over the next 18 to 24 months.
capex_expansion.quote: We have embarked on a 700-crore overall CAPEX cycle across all divisions of the company, not just in the next 12 months, but over the next 18 to 24 months.

capex_expansion.claim: About Rs. 400 crores of the capex is reserved for the polymer vertical to create new capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: About 400 crores of this is reserved for the Polymer vertical, where we are creating a lot of new capacity to cater to the existing business and also because we have to move out of the TVS campuses in which we had a lock-in period.

capex_expansion.claim: Approximately 150 to 180 crores of capex is allocated for the DICVS vertical and about 120 crores for the ACFMS vertical.
capex_expansion.quote: Approximately 150 to 180 crores will be for the DICVS vertical and about 120 crores for the ACFMS vertical, broadly speaking.

capex_expansion.claim: A center of excellence in polymer technology is being set up to become completely operational by May of 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: We are setting up a center of excellence in Polymer technology as we speak which will completely become operational by May of 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: The company planned a major capex cycle of about INR 680 crores to INR 700 crores for the year to cater to new businesses, new plants, and new machines.
capex_expansion.quote: In fact, this year, in itself, we have planned for about between INR 680 crore to INR 700 crores of CAPEX to cater to all of our new businesses that we have won, new plants, new machines, so on and so forth, which will keep propelling us forward and to maintain this growth momentum.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 revenue from operations reached Rs.1083.58 crores with an EBITDA of Rs.123.69 crores and an EBITDA margin of 11.41%.
margins_costs.quote: On a consolidated basis, our revenue from operations has been about Rs.1083.58 crores with an EBITDA of Rs.123.69 crores with an EBITDA margin of 11.41%

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax was Rs.67.02 crores with a PAT margin of 6.19% and an EPS of Rs.5.50.
margins_costs.quote: resulting in a profit after tax of Rs.67.02 crores with a PAT margin of 6.19%, resulting in an EPS of Rs.5.50 per one rupee share.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA faced headwinds due to soaring polymer prices, high LPG prices, increased freight costs, and sharp minimum wage hikes in three operating states.
margins_costs.quote: there have been multiple headwinds caused by the West Asia crisis. Polymer prices have gone through the roof. LPG prices have gone sky high. Freight costs have increased. There has been surge pricing. There has been premium pricing. And minimum wages in three states that we are operating have also gone up very sharply because of the government intervention in the 1st Quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects a softening of margins in P3L over two years due to forward investments in a center of excellence and personnel recruitment.
margins_costs.quote: So, there will be a softening of margins over two years before the benefits of all of this start kicking in.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that there is a lag factor of six months for foreign exchange corrections.
margins_costs.quote: There is a lag factor of six months. So, we are only now getting corrections of FOREX for the Q3 of the last financial year.

orders_capacity.claim: Pricol holds a 30-35% volume share in the two-wheeler DIS business in India.
orders_capacity.quote: in two wheeler DIS business we have largest in India with 30-35% volume share

orders_capacity.claim: The company has nearly a two-thirds market share in commercial vehicles and off-road vehicles for DIS.
orders_capacity.quote: in CVs we have almost two third market share to CVs off road vehicles

orders_capacity.claim: In passenger vehicles DIS, Pricol holds about 8-9% market share, entirely through supplies to Tata Motors.
orders_capacity.quote: In passenger vehicles, we just have about 8-9% market share because at this point in time, we are only dependent on Tata Motors, where 8 out of 10 Tata cars are coming out with a PRICOL cluster.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that loss of market share in instrument clusters is not a concern for the next three years due to confirmed LOIs for most programs.
orders_capacity.quote: Will we be able to maintain the market share for the foreseeable future for the next three years? I do not see any dip in market share because we have got confirmed LOIs for most of the programs.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported that capacity utilization in plastics has reached a peak, limiting growth in that segment for the year.
orders_capacity.quote: In fact, so much so that in plastics, we are unable to grow this year because of lack of capacity, which is why you see the ROCE at a very high figure compared to what I had given guidance for because of sweating the capital assets.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended retaining the dividend at 200% for FY26 to conserve cash given capital investments and headwinds.
capital_allocation.quote: So, this is something that we took a conscious call yesterday. We had the subject of the dividend, and the entire Board, including myself, recommended that we retain it at a 200% dividend for the FY26, see the performance for the next six months, and then take a call on that subject.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt as of March 31, 2026 stood at INR 63.11 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Just to give you a perspective, barring the supplier discounting and the customer bill discounting which earlier was hitherto treated as trade payable, now actual borrowing as of 31st March 2026, net debt is INR 63.11 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: The West Asia crisis and geopolitical factors caused adverse cost impacts on polymers, LPG, freight, and wages.
risks_headwinds.quote: there have been multiple headwinds caused by the West Asia crisis. Polymer prices have gone through the roof. LPG prices have gone sky high. Freight costs have increased.

risks_headwinds.claim: The rupee is at an all-time low against the US dollar, which hampers profitability due to reliance on imported electronic child parts.
risks_headwinds.quote: the resumption of the war in Iran and those neighboring regions will continue to have an impact on the rupee, which is at an all-time low against the US dollar. And since we are dependent on a significant amount of imports of electronic child parts for our business, this will continue to hamper our profitability

risks_headwinds.claim: Prices of memory-controlled devices are increasing sharply quarter-on-quarter due to the global AI revolution demand.
risks_headwinds.quote: even for memory controlled devices, which we are dependent on heavily, prices are increasing very, very sharply quarter on quarter because of the huge demand created by the AI revolution happening across the world.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted multiple headwinds this financial year including a semiconductor crisis, a rare earth magnet crisis, and the West Asia crisis.
risks_headwinds.quote: This financial year started off with a semiconductor crisis, followed by a rare earth magnet crisis, followed by the West Asia crisis.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that inbound and outbound freight costs are spiraling out of control.
risks_headwinds.quote: Freight costs are also spiraling out of control both inbound and outbound freight.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to recover earnings lost in the first quarter through quarterly indexing over the next two quarters.
management_commitments.quote: So, by the next two quarters, we will recover whatever earnings that we have lost this quarter on account of all these increases in costs and headwinds.

management_commitments.claim: Polymer business capacity creation and new business will take 9 to 12 months to mature, enabling a healthy (+20%) growth rate thereafter.
management_commitments.quote: We have won a lot of business for which we are creating capacity, but that will take the next 9-12 months to mature, after which that business also will maintain a very healthy (+20%) growth rate.

management_commitments.claim: Shipping providers indicate that inbound and outbound freight rates will remain very high for at least the next four quarters.
management_commitments.quote: the intelligence provided by them is at least for the next four quarters shipping rates and freight rates both inbound and outbound will continue to be very high.

management_commitments.claim: The demerger process is expected to take at a minimum 4 quarters or longer.
management_commitments.quote: we have been told it will take at the very minimum 4 quarters or could be longer.

management_commitments.claim: Internal operations as demerged entities will start by October and be fully operational by December.
management_commitments.quote: Internally we will be starting to operate like demerged entities by October and by December it will be fully operated like demerged entities so that when the demerger happens it becomes easy.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated production with BOE will commence in about 10 to 12 months.
management_commitments.quote: Work is under progress on the equipment and the machinery and the buildings, and we will be commencing in about 10 to 12 months' production.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that with Domino, revenue will start trickling in within 18 months to 24 months.
management_commitments.quote: With Domino, more like 18 months to 24 months is where we will be ready, and the early stages of revenue will start trickling in, right?

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
